market:
<view class="page">
  <view class="market-tabs"><button class="tab {{market === 'futures' ? 'active' : ''}}" data-market="futures" bindtap="setMarket">期货</button><button class="tab {{market === 'stock' ? 'active' : ''}}" data-market="stock" bindtap="setMarket">股票</button><view class="tab-status"><view class="pill">{{sourceLabel}}</view></view></view>
  <view class="search-row"><view class="search-box"><text class="search-icon">⌕</text><input class="search-input" value="{{query}}" placeholder="名称 / 代码" bindinput="search" aria-label="搜索名称或代码"/><button wx:if="{{query}}" class="clear-search" bindtap="clearSearch" aria-label="清空搜索">×</button></view><button class="watch-filter {{onlyWatchlist ? 'active' : ''}}" bindtap="toggleOnlyWatchlist">{{onlyWatchlist ? '★' : '☆'}} 自选</button></view>
  <view class="list-title row"><text>{{onlyWatchlist ? '我的自选' : market === 'stock' ? 'A股行情' : '期货行情'}}</text><button class="list-refresh" disabled="{{loading}}" bindtap="loadInstruments">{{loading ? '加载中' : '刷新'}}</button></view>
  <view class="table-head"><text>名称 / 代码</text><button data-sort="price" bindtap="sortBy">最新价 {{sort === 'price' ? (sortDirection === -1 ? '↓' : '↑') : '↕'}}</button><button data-sort="change" bindtap="sortBy">涨跌幅 {{sort === 'change' ? (sortDirection === -1 ? '↓' : '↑') : '↕'}}</button></view>
  <view wx:if="{{error}}" class="notice error">{{error}}<button class="secondary retry" bindtap="loadInstruments">重试</button></view>
  <view wx:if="{{!loading && !items.length}}" class="empty">{{onlyWatchlist ? '暂无自选' : '无匹配结果'}}</view>
  <view class="contract-list"><button wx:for="{{items}}" wx:key="symbol" class="contract" data-symbol="{{item.symbol}}" bindtap="openChart" aria-label="查看{{item.name}}{{item.code}}行情"><view class="contract-info"><view class="contract-name">{{item.name}}<text wx:if="{{item.favorite}}" class="favorite-dot">★</text></view><view class="contract-code">{{item.code}}<text>{{item.exchange}}</text></view></view><text class="price number {{item.direction}}">{{item.price}}</text><view class="change number {{item.direction}}">{{item.change}}</view></button></view>
</view>
chart:
<view class="page chart-page">
  <view class="contract-header row"><view><view class="contract-name">{{name || '行情'}}<text class="contract-code">{{code}}</text></view><view class="exchange">{{exchange}}</view></view><view class="row header-actions"><view class="pill">{{sourceLabel}}</view><button class="favorite-button {{favorite ? 'saved' : ''}}" bindtap="toggleFavorite" aria-label="{{favorite ? '移出自选' : '加入自选'}}">{{favorite ? '★' : '☆'}}</button></view></view>
  <view class="quote-panel"><view class="quote-main"><view class="last-price number {{quote.direction}}">{{quote.price}}</view><view class="quote-change number {{quote.direction}}">{{quote.change}}</view></view><view class="quote-stats"><view><text>开盘</text><text class="number">{{quote.open}}</text></view><view><text>最高</text><text class="number up">{{quote.high}}</text></view><view><text>最低</text><text class="number down">{{quote.low}}</text></view></view></view>
  <view wx:if="{{error}}" class="notice error error-block">{{error}}<text wx:if="{{dataset}}">，保留上次数据</text><button class="retry" disabled="{{loading}}" bindtap="refresh">重试</button></view>
  <view wx:if="{{warning}}" class="notice error">{{warning}}</view>
  <view class="chart-card card"><view class="row chart-toolbar"><view class="periods"><button wx:for="{{periods}}" wx:key="id" class="period {{timeframe === item.id ? 'active' : ''}}" data-period="{{item.id}}" bindtap="changePeriod">{{item.label}}</button></view><button class="signal-toggle {{showSignals ? 'active' : ''}}" bindtap="toggleSignals">{{showSignals ? '●' : '○'}} 买卖点</button></view>
    <view class="overlay-tabs"><button wx:for="{{overlays}}" wx:key="id" class="indicator-tab {{overlay === item.id ? 'active' : ''}}" data-overlay="{{item.id}}" bindtap="chooseOverlay">{{item.label}}</button><button class="history-button" disabled="{{!hasMore || loadingEarlier || loading}}" bindtap="loadEarlier">{{loadingEarlier ? '加载中' : hasMore ? '更早行情' : '全部已加载'}}</button></view>
    <view wx:if="{{selected}}" class="selected-bar"><text>{{selected.time}}</text><text>开 {{selected.open}}</text><text>高 {{selected.high}}</text><text>低 {{selected.low}}</text><text>收 {{selected.close}}</text></view>
    <view class="canvas-area"><kline-chart wx:if="{{dataset && barCount > 0}}" id="kline" dataset="{{dataset}}" show-signals="{{showSignals}}" overlay="{{overlay}}" subchart="{{subchart}}" bind:selectbar="selectBar"></kline-chart><view wx:else class="chart-empty">{{loading ? '加载中…' : '暂无行情'}}</view></view>
    <view class="row chart-footer"><view class="subchart-tabs"><button wx:for="{{subcharts}}" wx:key="id" class="indicator-tab {{subchart === item.id ? 'active' : ''}}" data-subchart="{{item.id}}" bindtap="chooseSubchart">{{item.label}}</button></view><view class="zoom-actions"><button data-mode="out" bindtap="zoom" aria-label="缩小图表">−</button><button data-mode="in" bindtap="zoom" aria-label="放大图表">＋</button><button data-mode="reset" bindtap="zoom">复位</button></view></view>
  </view>
  <view class="row refresh-row"><view class="update-time">{{updatedAt || '—'}}<text> · {{barCount}}根</text></view><button class="refresh" loading="{{loading}}" disabled="{{loading}}" bindtap="refresh">{{loading ? '加载中' : '刷新'}}</button></view>
  <view class="factor-section"><view class="row signals-heading"><text class="section-label">因子参考</text><text class="factor-period">{{timeframe === '1d' ? '日频' : timeframe}}</text></view><view class="factor-grid"><button wx:for="{{factorRows}}" wx:key="id" class="factor-item" data-factor="{{item.id}}" bindtap="explainFactor"><view class="factor-name">{{item.label}}</view><view class="factor-value number {{item.status !== 'ready' ? 'unavailable' : ''}}">{{item.state || item.display}}</view></button></view><view wx:if="{{factorDetail}}" class="factor-detail">{{factorDetail}}</view></view>
  <view class="signals-section"><view class="row signals-heading"><text class="section-label">交易信号</text><view class="legend"><text class="buy">买 {{buyCount}}</text><text class="sell">卖 {{sellCount}}</text></view></view><view class="signal-filters"><button class="{{signalFilter === 'all' ? 'active' : ''}}" data-filter="all" bindtap="chooseSignalFilter">全部</button><button class="{{signalFilter === 'buy' ? 'active' : ''}}" data-filter="buy" bindtap="chooseSignalFilter">买入</button><button class="{{signalFilter === 'sell' ? 'active' : ''}}" data-filter="sell" bindtap="chooseSignalFilter">卖出</button></view><view class="signals-table-head"><text>方向</text><text>信号时间</text><text>对应K线</text></view><view wx:if="{{!signalRows.length}}" class="empty">{{loading ? '加载中…' : '暂无信号'}}</view><button wx:for="{{signalRows}}" wx:key="id" class="signal-row" data-anchor="{{item.anchor}}" bindtap="focusSignal"><view class="signal-side {{item.side}}"><text class="signal-badge">{{item.letter}}</text>{{item.label}}</view><text class="number">{{item.time}}</text><text class="bar-time number">{{item.barTime}} ›</text></button></view>
  <view wx:if="{{debugMode}}" class="demo-settings row"><text>演示场景</text><picker mode="selector" range="{{scenarios}}" value="{{scenarioIndex}}" disabled="{{loading}}" bindchange="changeScenario"><view class="scenario-picker">{{scenarios[scenarioIndex]}}⌄</view></picker></view>
</view>
